purpose: Separate copy, messaging, and claim-governance graph derived from bounded public brand material.

nodes.label: Hellobiotic public copy and claims system
nodes.summary: A public-observation layer for message construction; it is not an internal approval matrix or legal substantiation file.

nodes.label: Playful, body-forward language
nodes.summary: Public language includes informal, body-positive phrases such as pit-care, pit stop, and everyBODY; it makes the category feel human rather than clinical.

nodes.label: Plain-language science bridge
nodes.summary: The site translates microbiome vocabulary into simple explanations of odor and everyday body care instead of using laboratory-heavy language.

nodes.label: Microbiome-friendly deodorant
nodes.summary: The official storefront presents this as a core product-positioning claim. It is attributable to the brand, not an independently established efficacy finding.

nodes.label: Pre, pro, and postbiotic formulation language
nodes.summary: The product page publicly describes a pre-, pro-, and postbiotic blend in its odor-care positioning.

nodes.label: Aluminum-free and baking-soda-free attributes
nodes.summary: These are public product attributes and may be repeated only after a live product-page verification for the specific SKU and market.

nodes.label: Not an antiperspirant
nodes.summary: The FAQ distinguishes the product from antiperspirants. Copy must not promise sweat blocking or imply that it is an antiperspirant.

nodes.label: No independent health, safety, or clinical-efficacy proof in the public corpus
nodes.summary: The available material is first-party product positioning. It cannot substantiate medical, safety, universal-results, or clinical-efficacy language.

nodes.label: Odor explainer module
nodes.summary: Proposed educational sequence: explain that odor is associated with bacteria on skin, then introduce the product's microbiome-friendly positioning. It is a creative adaptation, not approved copy.

nodes.label: Gentle ritual module
nodes.summary: Proposed way to connect body-care education to sunlit, tactile ritual imagery without implying medical outcomes.

nodes.label: Feed your skin
nodes.summary: Observed public brand phrase. Its use in a new asset still needs brand approval and current-usage verification.

nodes.label: No authorized copy deck, legal matrix, or channel-specific ad guidance
nodes.summary: No proprietary tone-of-voice guide, approved claims inventory, or paid-social copy framework was present in the bounded public research.
